SELECT
  'dim-' || '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' || '-item-' || replace(replace('${datetime}','-',''),'_','T') || 'Z' AS batch_id,
  '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS system_book,
  CAST('${date+8h}' AS DATE) AS snapshot,
  CAST(o.item_num AS VARCHAR) AS item_num,
  CAST(o.item_code AS VARCHAR) AS item_code,
  CAST(o.bar_code AS VARCHAR) AS bar_code,
  CAST(o.pinyin AS VARCHAR) AS pinyin,
  CAST(o.item_name AS VARCHAR) AS item_name,
  CAST(o.spec AS VARCHAR) AS spec,
  CAST(o.item_type AS VARCHAR) AS item_type,
  CAST(o.item_flag_names AS VARCHAR) AS item_flag_names,
  CAST(o.unit_name AS VARCHAR) AS unit_name,
  CAST(o.unit_group_name AS VARCHAR) AS unit_group_name,
  CAST(o.tax_code AS VARCHAR) AS tax_code,
  CAST(o.valid_period AS INTEGER) AS valid_period,
  CAST(o.made_in AS VARCHAR) AS made_in,
  CAST(o.eliminate_flag AS BOOLEAN) AS eliminate_flag,
  CAST(o.eliminate_at AS VARCHAR) AS eliminate_at,
  CAST(o.eliminate_operator AS VARCHAR) AS eliminate_operator,
  CAST(o.item_sale_cease_flag AS BOOLEAN) AS item_sale_cease_flag,
  CAST(o.description AS VARCHAR) AS description,
  CAST(o.item_point_value AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_point_value,
  CAST(o.item_sale_no_store AS BOOLEAN) AS item_sale_no_store,
  CAST(o.item_weight_flag AS BOOLEAN) AS item_weight_flag,
  CAST(o.item_in_tax AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_in_tax,
  CAST(o.item_out_tax AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_out_tax,
  CAST(o.free_tax_flag AS BOOLEAN) AS free_tax_flag,
  CAST(o.created_at AS VARCHAR) AS created_at,
  CAST(o.updated_at AS VARCHAR) AS updated_at,
  CAST(o.created_by AS BIGINT) AS created_by,
  CAST(o.creator AS VARCHAR) AS creator,
  CAST(o.updated_by AS BIGINT) AS updated_by,
  CAST(o.item_sequence AS INTEGER) AS item_sequence,
  CAST(o.deleted_flag AS BOOLEAN) AS deleted_flag,
  CAST(o.item_cost_mode AS VARCHAR) AS item_cost_mode,
  CAST(o.item_method AS VARCHAR) AS item_method,
  CAST(o.item_gross_rate AS VARCHAR) AS item_gross_rate,
  CAST(o.item_direct_rate AS VARCHAR) AS item_direct_rate,
  CAST(o.item_en_name AS VARCHAR) AS item_en_name,
  CAST(o.item_note_info AS VARCHAR) AS item_note_info,
  CAST(o.item_stock_cease_flag AS BOOLEAN) AS item_stock_cease_flag,
  CAST(o.item_status AS INTEGER) AS item_status,
  CAST(o.item_remind_period AS INTEGER) AS item_remind_period,
  CAST(o.item_transfer_day AS INTEGER) AS item_transfer_day,
  CAST(o.item_purchase_scope AS VARCHAR) AS item_purchase_scope,
  CAST(o.item_store_place AS VARCHAR) AS item_store_place,
  CAST(o.item_assist_unit AS VARCHAR) AS item_assist_unit,
  CAST(o.item_assist_rate AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_assist_rate,
  CAST(o.item_purchase_unit AS VARCHAR) AS item_purchase_unit,
  CAST(o.item_purchase_rate AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_purchase_rate,
  CAST(o.item_inventory_unit AS VARCHAR) AS item_inventory_unit,
  CAST(o.item_inventory_rate AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_inventory_rate,
  CAST(o.item_transfer_unit AS VARCHAR) AS item_transfer_unit,
  CAST(o.item_transfer_rate AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_transfer_rate,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_unit AS VARCHAR) AS item_wholesale_unit,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_rate AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_wholesale_rate,
  CAST(o.item_price_tag_flag AS BOOLEAN) AS item_price_tag_flag,
  CAST(o.item_print_label_flag AS BOOLEAN) AS item_print_label_flag,
  CAST(o.item_cost_price AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_cost_price,
  CAST(o.item_transfer_price AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_transfer_price,
  CAST(o.item_transfer_fix_type AS INTEGER) AS item_transfer_fix_type,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_fix_type AS INTEGER) AS item_wholesale_fix_type,
  CAST(o.item_fix_assist_transfer_price AS BOOLEAN) AS item_fix_assist_transfer_price,
  CAST(o.item_fix_assist_wholesale_price AS BOOLEAN) AS item_fix_assist_wholesale_price,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_price AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_wholesale_price,
  CAST(o.item_level2_wholesale AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_level2_wholesale,
  CAST(o.item_level3_wholesale AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_level3_wholesale,
  CAST(o.item_level4_wholesale AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_level4_wholesale,
  CAST(o.item_transfer_gross AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_transfer_gross,
  CAST(o.item_transfer_fixed_gross AS BOOLEAN) AS item_transfer_fixed_gross,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_gross AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_wholesale_gross,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_fixed_gross AS BOOLEAN) AS item_wholesale_fixed_gross,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_gross2 AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_wholesale_gross2,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_gross3 AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_wholesale_gross3,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_gross4 AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS item_wholesale_gross4,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_fixed_gross2 AS BOOLEAN) AS item_wholesale_fixed_gross2,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_fixed_gross3 AS BOOLEAN) AS item_wholesale_fixed_gross3,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_fixed_gross4 AS BOOLEAN) AS item_wholesale_fixed_gross4,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_fix_type2 AS INTEGER) AS item_wholesale_fix_type2,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_fix_type3 AS INTEGER) AS item_wholesale_fix_type3,
  CAST(o.item_wholesale_fix_type4 AS INTEGER) AS item_wholesale_fix_type4,
  CAST(o.item_manufacture_flag AS BOOLEAN) AS item_manufacture_flag,
  CAST(o.item_need_product_date AS BOOLEAN) AS item_need_product_date,
  CAST(o.item_price_adj AS INTEGER) AS item_price_adj,
  CAST(o.item_transfer_return_flag AS BOOLEAN) AS item_transfer_return_flag,
  CAST(o.no_stock_no_request AS BOOLEAN) AS no_stock_no_request,
  CAST(o.item_fix_assist_cost_price AS BOOLEAN) AS item_fix_assist_cost_price,
  CAST(o.test_market_end_date AS VARCHAR) AS test_market_end_date,
  CAST(o.new_crease AS VARCHAR) AS new_crease,
  CAST(o.request_not_over_center_stock AS BOOLEAN) AS request_not_over_center_stock,
  CAST(o.material_url AS VARCHAR) AS material_url,
  CAST(o.wholesale_book_allow_over_center_stock AS BOOLEAN) AS wholesale_book_allow_over_center_stock,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_department AS JSON), '$.id') AS BIGINT) AS item_department_id,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_department AS JSON), '$.item_department_name') AS VARCHAR) AS item_department_name,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_department AS JSON), '$.item_department_code') AS VARCHAR) AS item_department_code,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_category AS JSON), '$.category_code') AS VARCHAR) AS item_category_code,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_category AS JSON), '$.category_en_name') AS VARCHAR) AS item_category_en_name,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_category AS JSON), '$.category_name') AS VARCHAR) AS item_category_name,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_category AS JSON), '$.id') AS BIGINT) AS item_category_id,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_category AS JSON), '$.level') AS INTEGER) AS item_category_level,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_category AS JSON), '$.parent_id') AS BIGINT) AS item_category_parent_id,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_category AS JSON), '$.pinyin') AS VARCHAR) AS item_category_pinyin,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_category AS JSON), '$.sort') AS INTEGER) AS item_category_sort,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_category AS JSON), '$.tax_code') AS VARCHAR) AS item_category_tax_code,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_brand AS JSON), '$.brand_code') AS VARCHAR) AS item_brand_code,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_brand AS JSON), '$.brand_name') AS VARCHAR) AS item_brand_name,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_brand AS JSON), '$.brand_pinyin') AS VARCHAR) AS item_brand_pinyin,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.item_brand AS JSON), '$.id') AS BIGINT) AS item_brand_id
FROM input o
